definition:
ဠင်္ဃာပေတိ

(caus, of la`nghati.) causes to jump; causes to hop.
word: ဠင်္ဃာပေတိ

definition:
ဠာပုကဋာဟ

(adj.) the outer crust of a gourd used as a vessel.
ḷīyati is given at Dhtp 361 as a variant of ḍī to fly (see ḍeti), and expld as "ākāsa--gamana." Similarly at Dhtm 586 as "vehāsa--gamana."
ḷāpukaṭāha/adj./the outer crust of a gourd used as a vessel.
